# Claude cost vs quality: Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku compared

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Opus 5.5 at low effort — 0.98× the quality of Opus 5 @high for 0.13× its cost. Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Opus 5.5 at low effort · everyday tasks → Opus 5.5 at low effort · advanced reasoning → Opus 5.5 at medium effort · cutting-edge thinking → Opus 5.5 at high effort. Highest measured quality: Opus 5.5 at max effort (1.17× for 1.34× the cost).

Costs and qualities are relative to Opus 5 @high = 1.00. They are computed only from ratios measured on the same task, normalised per benchmark and combined by weighted median, from 93 sources · 196 benchmarks · 1479 measurements. Updated 2026-09-24. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude cost vs quality: Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku compared](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.

## Data

- [raw-data.csv](https://claude-models.agensse.com/raw-data.csv): every measured row (source, model, effort, task, harness, cost, tokens, score, reference), CC BY 4.0.
